title: Satin Nickel Towel Bar, 18-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Straight Bar - Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop cluttering your vanity and give towels a dedicated place to hang with a classic, space-saving wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

  • Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Wall-mounted design is an ideal use of space in smaller bathrooms
  • Complete your bath with matching pieces from the Carolina Collection
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty for long-term confidence

Specs

  • Product type: Towel bar (straight bar)
  • Center-to-center: 18 in
  • Overall dimensions: 20 in L x 2 in D x 3.5 in H
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount with concealed screw hardware
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates and all installation hardware (screws #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
